title: The Sixteenth Detention
author: Ines Ravensworth
blurb: Mara Halloran, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
